scope_summary: Replaced the superseded hardcoded PBS selector/manual Python installation with uv-backed environment preparation and schema-2 recorded interpreter/distribution identity. Retained standalone CLI binary acquisition/dispatch, fixed runtime publication and owned staging cleanup. Added boot flags, migration guidance, deployment pin, offline real-uv fixtures and a separate real-entrypoint CI smoke. No worker protocol/backend/pool/supervisor/HTTP lifecycle changes; no subagents, staging, commits, pushes, heavy local gates or real runtime provisioning.

changes.intent: Delegate interpreter/environment preparation and package resolution to uv; prefer recorded validated base; offline local reuse; validate before and after publication; reject legacy PBS inputs; adapt installer unit regressions.
Wire optional runtime-python and runtime-uv inputs, explicitly rejected legacy release input, and configuration regressions; leave backend dispatch intact.
Read-only embedded boot probe of CPython/venv/base/import paths, worker compatibility and installed distribution identity; not a worker protocol change.

Adapt existing integrity/publication/reuse/native-lock assertions to real uv offline synthetic wheels; add incompatible Python, dependency closure/failure, extras, missing-tool reuse, legacy migration and unsafe wheel cases.
Shared metadata-bearing synthetic wheels and existing host interpreter discovery; no runtime download.
Move zip to dev-dependencies because production extraction is removed; Cargo.lock unchanged.
Copy the official uv 0.11.29 executable into the image without baking a Python environment or changing non-root/ffmpeg/deno behavior.
Install pinned uv in native CI and invoke the separate repository-owned real Docker boot smoke after existing containment validation.
Require uv for offline installer fixtures while preserving existing shared gate sequencing.
Bounded actual entrypoint boot, CLI version, graceful stop, offline resident reuse with uv unavailable, unchanged manifest, and owned disposable-volume cleanup.
Lightweight orchestration checks for real entrypoint arguments, no implicit pin fallback, offline reuse and failure propagation.
Document uv ownership/prerequisites, request versus lock distinction, stable-base publication, schema-2 source plans, legacy rejection and unchanged unverified yt-dlp default.
Distinguish offline fixture gates, unchanged containment smoke and new networked real boot evidence.

test_notes: Actual local checks: uv 0.11.29 --version/help and composed venv/pip --help commands exited 0 without provisioning; official uv release/docs/source read successfully after sandbox TLS failures and approved read-only rerun. python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -v exited 0: 25 mock/stub script tests in 40.482s. Scoped rustfmt ran; final cargo fmt --check exited 0. Scoped git diff --check exited 0. Python ast.parse checked four changed/new Python files without executing the runtime probe. Protected baseline hash comparison found worker/backend/pool/supervisor/Cargo.lock/historical task records unchanged. Initial formatting check reported differences and one README-edit attempt failed before writing due to default GBK decoding; both corrected. No cargo build/check/test/clippy, Docker build/run or Python/yt-dlp provisioning was run locally. Native Windows/Linux real-uv fixtures, full Rust gates, container/base relocation and real upstream boot are pending CI. The unchanged 2026.09.23 default remains unverified; owner's PyPI metadata check returned 404, so the real boot gate may fail until an available exact pin is explicitly approved.
